findings.problem: W1 supports 'not designed for applications over water or coastal regions' (ATBD issue 2.10) plus the manual 'describes processing of imagery over land'. The correction is ESA's Sen2Cor, not Earth Search's, so 'Earth Search’s correction' misattributes it. The adjacent issue bullet already uses the supported wording ('its makers did not design for water'), so the same panel says two different things. Inventory I-31's title ('A land processor corrects the water pixels...') repeats the stronger form.
findings.suggested_fix: Write: 'ESA’s Sen2Cor, the processor behind Earth Search, is documented as not designed for water. ESA validates it at land sites only.' Use the same wording in the table row and in the I-31 title.

limitations: Read-only review of the repository at commit 4e89ea2. I ran no tests, no repository commands, and no network calls. The CLAUDE.md copy in the task context predates Phase B. I reviewed the repository file.

I did not check source pages. Quotes in the check records and the literature claims W1 to W11 were taken as bound. Other reviewers cover sources and recomputation. I recomputed shares and counts only from benchmarks/results/aqr-coverage.json, aqr-headers.json, and docs/assets/discovery/provenance.json.

The Discovery tab was read as text extracted with html.parser from the section id=discovery of docs/s2-options.html, plus targeted grep of the raw HTML and the template. I did not view it in a browser. Inventory fields that the renderer does not show (issue text, why) were read from options-inventory.json.
The Prototyping, Integration, and Tradeoffs tabs were scanned by keyword only for pre-Phase-B route wording. The Prototyping tab was not reviewed for accuracy.

Style checks were scripted: whitespace word counts per sentence, a sentence split at '. ' with common abbreviations protected, and regex for semicolons and 'should'. A sentence with unusual punctuation could be mis-split. The scan covered added lines of the 84a4a7e..4e89ea2 diff for Markdown, new or changed inventory strings, and the added Discovery text lines. It did not cover Python docstrings or test files.
The commit range includes Phase A work. Findings on lines Phase A added (for example work-plan.md:233) are reported because they sit in the reviewed commit.
I could not tell whether the owner authorized commit 4e89ea2. The Phase B record's 'Nothing is committed' line is reported only as a stale statement.
